screenshots.name: admin-reception-page
screenshots.description: ReceptionPage quick entry interface showing the last 20 receipts table with columns (Date, Receipt Number, Company Name, Quantity, Total) and action buttons (Import from RS, Create Receipt) at the top

mustContain: reception page with recent receipts table and action buttons

screenshots.validationNote: EN identical to admin-dashboard-en/admin-navigation-en (all 4 are same file). KA is unique. RU identical to admin-navigation-ru/admin-reception-menu-ru.

screenshots.name: admin-reception-create
screenshots.description: ReceiptFormModal for manual receipt creation showing two-part form: header section (receiptDate, receiptNumber, supplierId, warehouseId) and line items section (product search, unit, quantity, purchasePrice, salePrice, computed totals)

captureSteps.script: (() => { const buttons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const createBtn = buttons.find(b => b.querySelector('svg') && b.closest('[class*="action"], [class*="header"], [class*="toolbar"]')); return createBtn ? 'found create button' : 'buttons: ' + buttons.map(b => b.textContent.trim().substring(0, 30)).join(' | '); })()

mustContain: receipt creation modal with header fields and line items form

screenshots.validationNote: All 3 languages show receipt creation modal with header and line items. Distinct from other screenshots. PASS.

screenshots.name: admin-receptions-list
screenshots.description: ReceptionsPage full receivings list showing the 11-column table (Date, Invoice #, Contract #, Company, Department, Item, Qty, Price, Pkg Qty, Pkg Price, Total) with all historical receipt data and pagination

mustContain: receptions table with 11 columns of receipt data

screenshots.validationNote: All 3 languages are identical to admin-receptions-filters and admin-reception-export of same language. The content IS valid (shows receptions page with filters+table+export), but they must be distinct from filters/export basenames.

screenshots.name: admin-receptions-filters
screenshots.description: ReceptionsPage 11-field filter panel showing all filter inputs: dateFrom, dateTo, invoiceNumber, contractNumber, companyId, departmentId, itemName, priceFrom, priceTo, totalFrom, totalTo

captureSteps.script: (() => { const filterPanel = document.querySelector('[class*="filter"], [class*="search"], form'); if (filterPanel) { filterPanel.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'instant' }); return 'filter panel found'; } return 'no filter panel found'; })()

mustContain: filter panel with date range, text inputs, and select dropdowns

screenshots.validationNote: All 3 languages identical to admin-receptions-list of same language. Content shows filter panel but also the full page. Should be cropped or zoomed to show just the filter section distinctly.

screenshots.name: admin-reception-export
screenshots.description: Reception export functionality on the ReceptionsPage showing Excel and PDF export buttons/options available for exporting filtered receipt data

captureSteps.script: (() => { const buttons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const exportBtns = buttons.filter(b => b.textContent.toLowerCase().includes('export') || b.textContent.toLowerCase().includes('excel') || b.textContent.toLowerCase().includes('pdf') || b.querySelector('[class*="export"]')); return 'export buttons: ' + exportBtns.length + ' | all buttons: ' + buttons.map(b => b.textContent.trim().substring(0, 20)).join(' | '); })()

mustContain: export buttons or options for Excel and PDF on the receptions page

screenshots.validationNote: All 3 languages identical to admin-receptions-list of same language. Should show a distinct view (e.g., export dropdown open, or cropped to export buttons area).

screenshots.name: admin-reception-group
screenshots.description: ReceptionGroupPage showing receipts grouped by invoice number in an 8-column table (Invoice #, Date, Company, Department, Items Count, Total Qty, Total Amount, Actions) with 6-field filter panel

mustContain: reception group table with receipts aggregated by invoice number

screenshots.validationNote: All 3 languages show distinct Reception Group page with grouped data table. Unique from other screenshots. PASS.

screenshots.name: admin-reception-edit
screenshots.description: ReceivingEditModal showing 13 editable fields for an existing receipt: receiptDate, invoiceNumber, contractNumber, supplierId, warehouseId, productCode, productName, unit, quantity, purchasePrice, salePrice, packageQuantity, packagePrice

captureSteps.script: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr'); if (rows.length === 0) return 'no table rows found'; const firstRow = rows[0]; const editBtn = firstRow.querySelector('button'); return editBtn ? 'edit button found in first row' : 'no button in first row, row content: ' + firstRow.textContent.trim().substring(0, 60); })()

mustContain: edit modal with 13 editable fields for an existing receipt

screenshots.validationNote: All 3 languages show distinct Edit Receiving modal with form fields. Unique from other screenshots. PASS.
